results.title: CURIOUS
results.brief_description: Edie Kurzer approached curating CURIOUS much like she does when designing costume for film and TV – by taking inspiration from found objects and combining them to exceed their original function, while also avoiding the obvious.

constellations_primary.name: Clothing, country, character
constellations_primary.description: Edie Kurzer's costume design work on Judy & Punch and Picnic at Hanging Rock is part of a larger trend in Australian films and TV series.

results.description:
When Edie Kurzer is designing costumes for film and TV, she often takes inspiration from found objects. It’s a similar approach to how she has curated these cabinets of curios and memorabilia. Like the details of a costume, when presented together as a collection these objects become more than the sum of their parts. According to Kurzer, “each of the objects have a story to tell, brought together by the common denominator of the moving image”.

Within the cabinets, examples such as the Pez collection or the character figurines celebrate familiar film and TV characters that have escaped the frame and live on as part of our collective memory. Kurzer also acknowledges the behind-the-scenes roles of various creative departments in film and television production through the display of everyday items that are commonly used – a paintbrush, a pair of scissors or a handy wire coat hanger.

In collecting, creating and curating these objects for display, Kurzer adheres to her rule of avoiding the obvious and celebrating the unexpected.

You can see examples of Edie Kurzer’s costume work in The Story of the Moving Image.

results.title: Green grows the Mallee
results.brief_description: Describes the work of the Pomona Experimental Farm at Murrayville in Victoria, in the use of underground water. Bores were sunk and yielded ample water but problems had still to be overcome in the preparation of the irrigation area. The manufacturing processes of the Pomona Deep Well Turbine pump illustrate the care and engineering precision in the production assembly and testing of the pump units. Irrigation scheme using bore water provide Mallee farmers with security against the threat of drought.

results.title: Melbourne (no. 4)
results.brief_description:
General shots (rushes) of Melbourne ‘life’ from the 50s. All images very iconic and nostalgic.

Section 1. Several shots of daffodils in a park. Nice colour, long shots.

Section 2. Shots in a park near the Yarra looking towards the city.

Section 3. Shots of Fitzroy gardens, conservatory and Government House.

Section 4. Shots of large houses in Toorak.

Section 5. ANZAC day march in the city. Many people involved.
